description: event_type values of business events (spec F-35) written through the outbox to bank_logs. Bank-originated events have channel SYSTEM and a null request_id.

event_types.request.completed: every API request, with endpoint, response codes and duration
event_types.password_reset.requested: reset code issued, or a request for an unknown phone
event_types.password_reset.completed: password changed with a valid code
event_types.account.status_changed: account became dormant, active or closed
event_types.rollover.job_completed: a day-rollover job (maturity, dormancy, daily_close) finished for a business date
